newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca says wins U.S. Casodex patent battle.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca says wins U.S. Casodex patent battle.

text.p: UK bioscience company Zeneca Group Plc said on Thursday that the U.S. Court of Appeal for the Federal Circuit had upheld its right to sell cancer drug Casodex.
However, the company said the Appeals court had remanded to the District Court a related matter of whether Zeneca had infringed the patent before Zeneca received its licence from Roussel-Uclaf.
Casodex won U.S. approval in October 1995 and the company said it was currently receiving more than half of all new U.S. prescriptions for patients with prostate cancer.
On Wednesday Zeneca announced a 21 percent increase in its U.S. sales force to cope with the rush of new products, including Casodex.
The company said the 250 staff added to the salesforce on a contract basis would be used to market its cardiovascular range, including Zestril and Sular.
